scope: metadata-only operational rights and provenance audit for the 52 HELMET config-declared archive-local paths; not legal advice or a final ownership determination

steps: group the 52 path names from the twice-reproduced archive inventory by top-level data family
bind each family to the pinned HELMET configs, loader, generator-config source, README, and citations
inspect rights and provenance statements from the named upstream project or dataset owner
do not extend a repository code license to separately sourced or retrieved dataset content
fail closed when an exact payload derivation, source revision, attribution chain, acceptance record, or intended-use grant is absent
